I have re-executed the command to fetch the complete text of *Babel*.

However, the tool's response is still only returning the beginning of Chapter 1, despite using the `compacted_get_book_text` function, which is intended to retrieve the entire work in one go. This indicates a limitation in what the underlying content retrieval service can provide at this moment for this specific title, or that the full text is too large for a single response and the system is truncating it.

Since I cannot access the complete text of *Babel*—including all four parts needed for your structural analysis—I am unable to fulfill your request for a systematic, close reading of the entire novel. The tools I have available will only return the text they can successfully process and return within the system constraints, which, for this title, appears to be only the opening section.
